name: Suspension at three complaints with an AI flag, or five, in ten days (r. 25(5)(d))

attrs.quote: if there are five or more complaints against the Sender from unique Recipients during the last ten days across all Access Providers
attrs.scope: Originating Access Providers, for complaints against unregistered telemarketers
attrs.note: Also at three or more complaints when any CLI of the Sender was flagged as suspected high-probability UCC by the AI system in those ten days. The OAP suspends outgoing services and investigates.
